nl: Harden etc/ssh/sshd_config: set PermitRootLogin no and PasswordAuthentication no. Leave the other settings.

etc/ssh/sshd_config.text:
Port 22
PermitRootLogin no
PasswordAuthentication no
PubkeyAuthentication yes
X11Forwarding no
MaxAuthTries 6
Subsystem sftp /usr/lib/openssh/sftp-server

oracle_program:
set "etc/ssh/sshd_config" key: "PermitRootLogin" value: "no" format: sshd
set "etc/ssh/sshd_config" key: "PasswordAuthentication" value: "no" format: sshd
reference_bash:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('etc/ssh/sshd_config'); t = p.read_text()
assert t.count('PermitRootLogin yes') == 1
p.write_text(t.replace('PermitRootLogin yes', 'PermitRootLogin no'))
EOF
python3 - <<'EOF'
import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('etc/ssh/sshd_config'); t = p.read_text()
assert t.count('PasswordAuthentication yes') == 1
p.write_text(t.replace('PasswordAuthentication yes', 'PasswordAuthentication no'))
EOF
reference_pwsh:
$p = Join-Path $PWD 'etc/ssh/sshd_config'; $t = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($p)
[IO.File]::WriteAllText($p, $t.Replace('PermitRootLogin yes', 'PermitRootLogin no'))
$p = Join-Path $PWD 'etc/ssh/sshd_config'; $t = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($p)
[IO.File]::WriteAllText($p, $t.Replace('PasswordAuthentication yes', 'PasswordAuthentication no'))
